# Business Operations Packs: store.amosmignery.dev

Public storefront for my Whop catalog. Generated by `storefront/build_site.js` in the private
**agent-products** repo. Do not edit `index.html` by hand; regenerate instead.

- **Site:** https://store.amosmignery.dev (GitHub Pages)
- **Checkout:** Whop (per-product checkout links)
- **No product files live here.** Covers and marketing copy only.

## Regenerate
1. From `agent-products/storefront`:
   - `node build_catalog.js`
   - `node collect_links.js`
   - `node build_site.js`
2. Copy `store-repo/*` into this repo, commit, push.
